findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "webmcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ni_replyflow_subscribe · Public sink: ni_replyflow_subscribe · Destructive: ni_gapscan_run, ni_bridgeai_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ni_replyflow_subscribe · Public sink: ni_replyflow_subscribe · Destructive: ni_gapscan_run, ni_bridgeai_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
